review_notes: I read the whole file and the definition of `rowCofactor` in FlowPiola.lean. I also grepped for other uses of `rowCofactor`. Elsewhere it is used only as an opaque matrix, in hypotheses of `vecDiv_rowCofactorPiola` and in its xFlowInv specialisation. I found no other proof that repeats this derivative-transport argument. Nothing was compiled, so I make no claim about whether the proposed rewrite would build.

claims.reason:
The four copies are real, but they are mechanical bookkeeping, not nontrivial repeated reasoning. The only mathematical content is that a 2×2 cofactor entry is ± the opposite entry of the matrix. Each `rowCofactor_ij` lemma is a one-line `simp [rowCofactor, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Matrix.det_fin_two]`, which is routine unfolding. Each `hq..fun`, `hq..` and `hQ..` block is `funext` plus `rw` plus `exact (hgrad a b)[.neg]`. That is a thin wrapper around `HasFDerivAt.neg`, `HasFDerivAt.fderiv` and the already-proved `hgrad`.

The proposed refactor would not clearly improve maintenance. The concrete indices and signs would become `Fin.rev` and `(-1)^(i+j)` arithmetic. `hdiv0` and `hdiv1` use specific entries `(0,0)`, `(1,0)`, `(0,1)` and `(1,1)` together with the two components of `hsecond`. After the change they would have to reduce `(-1:ℝ)^((i:ℕ)+j)`, `Fin.rev` and a smul on concrete literals. That likely adds `simp` fragility without removing any mathematical argument. The proposed lemma is also only sketched: the smul-versus-neg form of the derivative and the cast `((i:Fin 2):ℕ)` are not worked out.

The duplication is better handled as a local tidy-up. `hq..` and `hQ..` are redundant, since `hQ` could be derived from `hq..fun` and `hgrad` directly. That is a cleanup that moves branches inside a helper, which the rubric excludes. It is not a shared lemma capturing reusable reasoning. No other proof in the repository repeats the machinery, so there is no second site for a shared lemma.

evidence.excerpt:
rowCofactor A 0 0 = A 1 1 := by
  simp [rowCofactor, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Matrix.det_fin_two]

have hq01 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => rowCofactor (gradMatrix M y) 0 1) x =
      -Lg 1 0 := by rw [hq01fun]; exact (hgrad 1 0).neg.fderiv

have hdiv1 :
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => rowCofactor (gradMatrix M y) 0 1) x)
          (basisVec 0) +
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => rowCofactor (gradMatrix M y) 1 1) x)
          (basisVec 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hq01, hq11]

def rowCofactor (G : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  Matrix.adjugate (Matrix.transpose G)
